protocol.hypothesis: Trade continuation or reversal after a fully completed abnormal UTC day. Daily open-to-close log return, z-score relative to prior 20 daily returns (mean/std ddof=0, both shifted). Absolute z>=1.5 or >=2.0; side uses sign of actual daily return. One entry attempt at next day 00:01 UTC; stop 2 completed-hour ATR, no target, timeout 23h. Not paper replication; no symbol-specific sign rules.
protocol.selection_rule: Require positive development AND selection, >=30 selection trades, selection PF>=1.15 and DD<8%; highest selection PF wins; listed order breaks ties. Otherwise reject without opening holdout.
protocol.admission: Both independent periods positive, PF>=1.15 DD<8%; >=100 trades combined; both periods positive with adverse execution doubled to 9bps per side and both threshold neighbors +/-10%. No retuning or candidate switching. Prospective observation still required.
protocol.independence: Jan-Jun2024 already inspected in round3: screening only. Jul-Nov2024 never loaded in prior rounds; reserved. Paper sample ends Sep2019. Dec2023 warmup.
limitations: Original study spot assets/venues and different rule design; no transfer assumed.
